fullContentHtml:
MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Online Form 2026 – Extend - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Notification for the Primary & Middle School Teacher Post. The Applications for the MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 has Started from 21 August 2026, & Candidate can apply till 04 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 August 2026
  • Last Date : 18 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 18 September 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 20 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 12 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 1000/-
  • Portal Charge : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

MPESB Primary & Middle School Teacher Online Form 2026 – Extend is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 18 September 2026.
